cohort: The study included gilts, primiparous, and pluriparous sows from a 400-sow herd, with 6033 piglets from 426 litters contributing to birth weight assessment.
finding: Peforelin treatment significantly improved estrus rate, farrowing efficiency index, and live piglet index, and also improved piglet birth weight for specific sow subcategories (1st parity and older sows) and for all gilts and sows during the late summer infertility period.
followup_time: Piglet birth weight was assessed within 24 hours after birth; other reproductive performance outcomes were assessed subsequently, implying a follow-up until farrowing.
birth_weight: 6033 piglets from 426 litters were weighed individually within 24 hours after birth.
